keywords.def: The condition of lacking enough money, resources, or opportunities to meet basic needs and live with dignity.
Complete and not influenced by comparison
Measured in comparison to others or to a specific context rather than by a fixed standard.
The ability or opportunity to use, reach, or obtain something important.
A state of uncertainty or lack of safety, stability, or protection
A chance or possibility to improve one’s situation.
The middle value in a set of numbers, where half are higher and half are lower.

sentences.en: What does poverty really mean? When we hear the word poverty, I think many of us imagine extreme situations, like homelessness, starvation, or people living in very poor conditions.
sentences.zh: 贫困到底意味着什么？当我们听到“贫困”这个词时，我想很多人都会想到极端的情况，比如无家可归、挨饿，或者生活在非常恶劣的条件下。

sentences.en: But poverty is far more complex, and far more widespread, than we often realise.
sentences.zh: 但贫困远比我们通常意识到的要复杂得多，也普遍得多。

sentences.en: According to the United Nations, more than 700 million people (around 10 percent of the world’s population) still live in extreme poverty.
sentences.zh: 根据联合国的数据，仍有超过7亿人（约占世界人口的10%）生活在极端贫困之中。

sentences.en: These people are surviving on less than two dollars a day.
sentences.zh: 这些人每天靠不到两美元的生活费维生。

sentences.en: And despite decades of progress, this number is rising again.
sentences.zh: 尽管几十年来取得了进展，但这个数字又在上升。

sentences.en: But poverty is not only about income. It’s also about access to healthcare, education, decent work, social protection, and the power to make choices about your own life.
sentences.zh: 然而，贫困不仅关乎收入。它还关乎人们获得医疗保健、教育、体面工作、社会保障的渠道，以及对自身生活做出选择的权力。

sentences.en: Poverty is also deeply connected to human rights.
sentences.zh: 贫困也与人权息息相关。

sentences.en: Issues like child labour, forced labour, and human trafficking are often direct consequences of poverty and economic insecurity.
sentences.zh: 童工、强迫劳动和人口贩运等问题往往是贫困和经济不安全的直接后果。

sentences.en: This is why poverty remains one of the most important global issues today, and why “No Poverty” is the number one goal in the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么贫困在今天依然是全球最重要的议题之一，也是为什么“消除贫困”成为联合国可持续发展目标中的首要目标。

sentences.en: In this Thinking in English episode, we’ll explore what poverty really is, how it’s measured, why people fall into poverty and struggle to escape it, whether it’s actually possible to reduce or even end poverty, and finally, how the language we use to talk about poverty changes the way we understand it.
sentences.zh: 在本期Thinking in English节目中，我们将探讨贫困究竟是什么、它是如何被衡量的、人们为什么会陷入贫困并难以摆脱、减少甚至终结贫困是否真的可能，以及最后，我们用来谈论贫困的语言如何改变了我们的理解方式。

sentences.en: What do we actually mean when we talk about poverty?
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论贫困时，我们实际指的是什么？

sentences.en: I think the simplest definition of poverty is not having enough resources, money, or food or shelter, to live with dignity.
sentences.zh: 我认为，贫困最简单的定义就是没有足够的资源、金钱、食物或住所来维持有尊严的生活。

sentences.en: But this is only the starting point. Poverty is also about health, education, opportunity, safety, and power.
sentences.zh: 但这只是起点。贫困还关乎健康、教育、机会、安全和权力。

sentences.en: The United Nations is very clear on this.
sentences.zh: 联合国对此非常明确。

sentences.en: Poverty is multidimensional.
sentences.zh: 贫困是多维度的。

sentences.en: A person can have an income and still be poor.
sentences.zh: 一个人可能有收入，但仍然可能是贫穷的。

sentences.en: Someone can be working and still unable to afford healthcare or housing or education.
sentences.zh: 有人可能在工作，却仍然承担不起医疗、住房或教育费用。

sentences.en: Poverty is often about lack of access. To understand this better, it helps to look at different types of poverty.
sentences.zh: 贫困往往表现为机会的匮乏。为了更好地理解这一点，我们有必要了解不同类型的贫困。

sentences.en: Absolute poverty is the most extreme and visible form of poverty, and the type most people think of when they hear the word “poverty”.
sentences.zh: 绝对贫困是最极端、最显而易见的贫困形式，也是大多数人在听到“贫困”一词时首先想到的类型。

sentences.en: It refers to a situation where people lack the basic necessities for survival.
sentences.zh: 它指的是人们缺乏生存所需的基本必需品。

sentences.en: When people don’t have enough food, clean water, clothing, or healthcare.
sentences.zh: 当人们没有足够的食物、干净的水、衣物或医疗保健时。

sentences.en: Absolute poverty is usually measured using an international poverty line, which is currently set around $3 a day I think.
sentences.zh: 绝对贫困通常使用国际贫困线来衡量，我想目前大约设定在每天3美元左右。

sentences.en: If you earn less money than this, you are in “absolute poverty”.
sentences.zh: 如果你赚的钱比这少，你就处于“绝对贫困”之中。

sentences.en: According to global estimates, around 700 to 760 million people worldwide still live in absolute poverty.
sentences.zh: 根据全球估计，全球仍有大约7.00亿至7.60亿人生活在绝对贫困中。

sentences.en: Relative poverty looks very different. Relative poverty looks at whether a person has enough resources to live well and survive in the society they live in.
sentences.zh: 相对贫困看起来截然不同。相对贫困关注的是一个人拥有的资源是否足以在其生活的社会中良好生活和生存。

sentences.en: Relative poverty is measured in comparison to others in the same community as you.
sentences.zh: 相对贫困是通过与你所在社区的其他人的对比来衡量的。

sentences.en: Experts often define this type of poverty as living on less than half of the median income in a country or region.
sentences.zh: 专家通常将这种类型的贫困定义为收入低于某个国家或地区中位数的一半。

sentences.en: This type of poverty is common in wealthy nations.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的贫困在富裕国家很常见。

sentences.en: If you have a job in the UK or the US or Canada or Japan, you are most likely, almost definitely, above the absolute poverty line.
sentences.zh: 如果你在英国、美国、加拿大或日本有工作，你极大概率、几乎确定是在绝对贫困线之上。

sentences.en: But this does not mean you have enough money to live well in your society.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着你有足够的钱在你的社会里过上好日子。

sentences.en: Take the US as an example. The federal, meaning national, poverty line in the US in 2018 was $12,140 for an individual.
sentences.zh: 以美国为例。2018年，美国联邦（即国家）贫困线规定单身个人为12140美元。

sentences.en: But in San Francisco, a city with an incredibly high cost of living, an individual earning $82,000 a year in 2018 was considered low income by government standards.
sentences.zh: 但在生活成本高得惊人的旧金山，2018年年收入82000美元的个人按政府标准也被认为是低收入人群。

sentences.en: While $82,000 a year sounds like an amazing salary in most of the world, and most of the USA, in San Francisco, the median rent for a one bedroom apartment is around $3,500.
sentences.zh: 虽然在世界上大多数地方以及美国大部分地区，年收入82000美元听起来是一笔惊人的薪水，但在旧金山，一居室公寓的租金中位数约为3500美元。

sentences.en: After taxes and high costs for food, a person might still struggle to meet their basic needs, even on a great salary.
sentences.zh: 扣除税收以及高昂的食品开支后，即使拿着很高的薪水，一个人可能仍然难以满足其基本需求。

sentences.en: In fact, in many developed countries around one in six people might live in relative poverty.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在许多发达国家，大约六分之一的人可能生活在相对贫困中。

sentences.en: And this shows that poverty exists everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这表明贫困无处不在。

sentences.en: This brings us to multidimensional poverty, which is a concept strongly supported and talked about by the UN.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了多维贫困，这是一个得到联合国强烈支持和讨论的概念。

sentences.en: Multidimensional poverty recognizes that income alone does not explain people’s lives.
sentences.zh: 多维贫困认识到，仅凭收入无法解释人们的生活。

sentences.en: Poverty also includes limited access to education or poor healthcare.
sentences.zh: 贫困还包括教育机会有限或医疗条件差。

sentences.en: It could also include unsafe housing or no housing, a lack of security or limited opportunities.
sentences.zh: 它也可能包括不安全或没有住房、缺乏保障或机会有限。

sentences.en: For example, someone might earn slightly above the international poverty line, but live in unsafe housing with no healthcare and have no schooling.
sentences.zh: 例如，某人的收入可能略高于国际贫困线，但却住在没有医疗保障的不安全住房里，也没有受过教育。

sentences.en: On paper, they are not absolutely poor, but in reality, their options are extremely limited.
sentences.zh: 在纸面上，他们并不绝对贫困，但在现实中，他们的选择极其有限。

sentences.en: Poverty can also be understood in terms of time.
sentences.zh: 贫困也可以从时间维度来理解。

sentences.en: Situational poverty is caused by sudden events.
sentences.zh: 突发性贫困是由突发事件引起的。

sentences.en: You may find yourself in poverty or below the poverty line after losing your job.
sentences.zh: 你可能会在失业后发现自己陷入贫困或落入贫困线以下。

sentences.en: Maybe becoming seriously ill, or experiencing a natural disaster like a hurricane or an earthquake, or living through a conflict.
sentences.zh: 也许是得了重病，或者经历了飓风或地震等自然灾害，抑或是经历了冲突。

sentences.en: This type of poverty is often temporary, but without support it can become long term.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的贫困通常是暂时的，但如果没有支持，它可能会变成长期的。

sentences.en: Generational poverty, on the other hand, is passed down from one generation to the next.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，代际贫困是从一代传给下一代的。

sentences.en: Children born into poverty often lack good education, safe housing, and stable jobs.
sentences.zh: 出生在贫困中的儿童往往缺乏良好的教育、安全的住房和稳定的工作。

sentences.en: So as adults, they are far more likely to remain poor themselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们成年后，他们自己继续保持贫穷的可能性要大得多。

sentences.en: This creates a cycle that is extremely difficult to break.
sentences.zh: 这就形成了一个极难打破的循环。

sentences.en: Now we know a little about the different types of poverty, let’s take a few minutes to think about measuring poverty.
sentences.zh: 现在我们对不同类型的贫困有了些许了解，让我们花几分钟来思考如何衡量贫困。

sentences.en: The most common way to measure poverty is through “poverty lines “.
sentences.zh: 衡量贫困最常见的方法是通过“贫困线”。

sentences.en: I’ve mentioned these already in the episode.
sentences.zh: 我在节目中已经提到过这些了。

sentences.en: At the global level, organizations like the World Bank and UN use an international poverty line, which is currently set around $3 a day.
sentences.zh: 在全球层面，世界银行和联合国等机构使用的是国际贫困线，目前大约设定在每天3美元左右。

sentences.en: This line is designed to measure extreme and absolute poverty.
sentences.zh: 这条线旨在衡量极端和绝对贫困。

sentences.en: However, this figure is not meant to describe what a decent life looks like everywhere.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个数字并不是用来描述各地体面生活样子的。

sentences.en: It is a minimum across the world. It is not a comfortable standard of living.
sentences.zh: 它是全球的最低标准。它并非一个舒适的生活标准。

sentences.en: That’s why countries also use their own national poverty lines.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么各国也会使用本国的国家贫困线。

sentences.en: These are set based on local costs and living standards.
sentences.zh: 这些标准是根据当地成本和生活水平设定的。

sentences.en: Some cities and regions also have their own, like how in San Francisco the poverty line or low income line for an individual is over $80,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 一些城市和地区也有自己的标准，就像在旧金山，个人贫困线或低收入线每年超过80000美元一样。

sentences.en: What counts as poverty in one country may be very different in another.
sentences.zh: 在一个国家算作贫困的标准，在另一个国家可能会截然不同。

sentences.en: The poverty line in a high income country is much higher than in a low income one, because housing and food and transport are all more expensive.
sentences.zh: 高收入国家的贫困线远高于低收入国家，因为住房、食物和交通都更昂贵。

sentences.en: Traditionally, poverty has been measured using income.
sentences.zh: 传统上，贫困是通过收入来衡量的。

sentences.en: Measuring how much money people earn or spend.
sentences.zh: 衡量人们赚了多少钱或花了多少钱。

sentences.en: But income doesn’t tell us how people actually live.
sentences.zh: 但收入并不能告诉我们人们实际是如何生活的。

sentences.en: Two people with the same income may have very different lives depending on where they live or their education.
sentences.zh: 两个收入相同的人，由于居住地或教育背景不同，生活可能会有很大差异。

sentences.en: Even in the same city, one person may have access to affordable housing, while another person has to pay two or three times more for their apartment.
sentences.zh: 即使在同一个城市，一个人可能负担得起住房，而另正一个人则不得不为公寓支付两到三倍的费用。

sentences.en: Because of this, many organizations also look at living standards, which measures more than just income.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，许多机构也开始关注生活水平，这不仅衡量收入。

sentences.en: But measuring poverty has serious limitations.
sentences.zh: 但衡量贫困有着严重的局限性。

sentences.en: A dollar goes much further in some countries or regions than others.
sentences.zh: 一美元在某些国家或地区的购买力远大于其他地方。

sentences.en: Even within the same country, living costs can vary hugely between cities and rural areas.
sentences.zh: 即使在同一个国家内，城市和农村地区的生活成本也可能差异巨大。

sentences.en: For example, my income is good for where I live in Japan.
sentences.zh: 例如，我的收入对于我居住的日本地方来说是不错的。

sentences.en: It would be okay for the suburbs of Tokyo, but I would be poor in some areas of Central Tokyo and probably really poor in a place like New York.
sentences.zh: 对于东京郊区来说还可以，但在东京市中心的某些地方我就会变穷，而在纽约这样地方可能真的会很穷。

sentences.en: Another problem is informal work. Hundreds of millions of people earn money through informal or undocumented jobs.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是灰色经济或非正式工作。数以亿计的人通过非正式或无证工作赚钱。

sentences.en: Their income is unstable, unpredictable, and often invisible in official statistics.
sentences.zh: 他们的收入不稳定、不可预测，并且在官方统计中往往是隐形的。

sentences.en: And there is also hidden poverty. Some people earn just above the poverty line, but still struggle to afford housing or food or healthcare.
sentences.zh: 此外还有隐性贫困。有些人赚的钱刚好在贫困线以上，但仍然难以负担住房、食物或医疗。

sentences.en: Measuring poverty is obviously necessary, but it will never be exact.
sentences.zh: 衡量贫困显然是必要的，但它永远不会百分之百精确。

sentences.en: It will always be an approximation. Why does poverty exist in the first place?
sentences.zh: 它永远只是一种近似值。贫困究竟为什么会存在？

sentences.en: Well, I don’t think there is one single cause of poverty.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为贫困并不是由单一原因造成的。

sentences.en: Instead, poverty is usually the result of multiple different factors.
sentences.zh: 相反，贫困通常是多种不同因素共同作用的结果。

sentences.en: One of the most direct causes is economic insecurity.
sentences.zh: 最直接的原因之一是经济不稳定。

sentences.en: Many people are poor because their work is unstable or badly paid.
sentences.zh: 许多人贫穷是因为他们的工作不稳定或薪酬微薄。

sentences.en: Unemployment, informal jobs, underemployment, and low wages all make it difficult to plan for the future.
sentences.zh: 失业、非正式工作、就业不足和低工资都使得人们难以规划未来。

sentences.en: Even in wealthy countries, millions of people have jobs but still can’t afford housing or basic services.
sentences.zh: 即使在富裕国家，数百万人有工作却依然承担不起住房或基本服务。

sentences.en: Education also plays a long-term role in poverty.
sentences.zh: 教育在贫困中也扮演着长期角色。

sentences.en: Limited access to education or poor quality education reduces your opportunities.
sentences.zh: 教育机会有限或教育质量差会减少你的机会。

sentences.en: If you are unable to read, write, or do basic mathematics, you are obviously going to have fewer job opportunities and a lower average earning potential.
sentences.zh: 如果你不会读写或做基本的数学运算，你的工作机会自然会减少，平均收入潜力也会更低。

sentences.en: This creates a cycle. Children born into poor families are more likely to attend underfunded schools or leave education early, which increases their risk of poverty as adults.
sentences.zh: 这就形成了一个循环。出生在贫困家庭的儿童更有可能去资金不足的学校上学或提早辍学，这增加了他们成年后陷入贫困的风险。

sentences.en: Health and poverty are also deeply connected.
sentences.zh: 健康与贫困也紧密相连。

sentences.en: Illness can push people into poverty by reducing their ability to work or forcing them to spend large amounts of money on their health.
sentences.zh: 疾病会削弱工作能力或迫使人们花巨资治病，从而将人们推向贫困。

sentences.en: In countries without strong or universal healthcare, like the USA, medical costs are one of the leading causes of financial hardship.
sentences.zh: 在没有健全或全民医保的国家（如美国），医疗费用是导致经济困难的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: At the same time, poverty increases health risks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，贫困也增加了健康风险。

sentences.en: Poor health leads to poverty, and poverty leads to poor health.
sentences.zh: 健康状况不佳导致贫困，而贫困又导致健康状况不佳。

sentences.en: Social and political systems also affect who experiences poverty.
sentences.zh: 社会和政治制度也影响着谁会经历贫困。

sentences.en: Discrimination, for example, can limit people’s access to education or jobs.
sentences.zh: 例如，歧视会限制人们获得教育或工作的机会。

sentences.en: Conflict and war are among the most extreme causes of poverty.
sentences.zh: 冲突和战争是导致贫困的最极端原因之一。

sentences.en: Violence destroys infrastructure. It disrupts education.
sentences.zh: 暴力摧毁了基础设施。它扰乱了教育。

sentences.en: It displaces people and it collapses economies.
sentences.zh: 它使人流离失所，并导致经济崩溃。

sentences.en: And poverty is of course influenced by global forces.
sentences.zh: 贫困当然也受到全球力量的影响。

sentences.en: Climate change, for example, is already increasing poverty by destroying crops and homes and livelihoods, especially in countries that depend on agriculture.
sentences.zh: 例如，气候变化正在通过摧毁农作物、房屋和生计来加剧贫困，尤其是在依赖农业的国家。

sentences.en: And natural disasters hit poorer communities hardest because they have fewer resources to recover.
sentences.zh: 自然灾害对较贫困社区打击最大，因为他们拥有的恢复资源更少。

sentences.en: Finally, global inequality also matters.
sentences.zh: 最后，全球不平等也很重要。

sentences.en: Things like trade systems and debt and unequal access to technology mean that some countries will struggle to develop even when their populations are working hard.
sentences.zh: 诸如贸易体系、债务以及对技术的不平等获取等手段意味着，即使其民众努力工作，一些国家也难以实现发展。

sentences.en: You may have heard the term poverty trap before.
sentences.zh: 你可能以前听过“贫困陷阱”这个词。

sentences.en: The basic idea is that poverty traps people.
sentences.zh: 其基本理念是贫困会困住人们。

sentences.en: Once they are in poverty, it’s difficult to escape.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们陷入贫困，就很难逃脱。

sentences.en: Poverty is a cycle. Once someone falls into poverty, a series of linked problems can keep them there, even if they work hard or make responsible choices.
sentences.zh: 贫困是一个循环。一旦某人陷入贫困，一系列相互关联的问题就会让他们留在那儿，即使他们努力工作或做出负责任的选择也是如此。

sentences.en: Each problem reinforces the next, making escape from the poverty trap difficult.
sentences.zh: 每个问题都在加剧下一个问题，使得摆脱贫困陷阱变得困难重重。

sentences.en: One common poverty trap looks like this.
sentences.zh: 一个常见的贫困陷阱是这样的。

sentences.en: Low income leads to poor nutrition and limited access to healthcare.
sentences.zh: 低收入导致营养不良和医疗资源有限。

sentences.en: This makes the person ill. The person’s poor health then reduces their ability to work consistently or productively.
sentences.zh: 这使人生病。此人糟糕的健康状况进而削弱了他们持续或高效工作的能力。

sentences.en: This leads to even lower income… and the cycle continues.
sentences.zh: 这导致收入更低……循环往复。

sentences.en: Another trap involves financial insecurity.
sentences.zh: 另一个陷阱涉及经济不安全。

sentences.en: People living in poverty often have no savings.
sentences.zh: 生活在贫困中的人通常没有积蓄。

sentences.en: This means that an unexpected cost, like a medical bill or your refrigerator breaking or a family emergency, must be paid for with debt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一笔意料之外的开销，比如医疗账单、冰箱坏了或家庭紧急情况，必须通过负债来支付。

sentences.en: Debt usually comes with high interest rates, especially for people with no access to banking or poor credit.
sentences.zh: 债务通常伴随着高利率，对于无法接触银行服务或信用不佳的人来说尤其如此。

sentences.en: Over time, repayments take up more and more income, making it even harder to save or invest for the future.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，还款额消耗了越来越多的收入，使得为未来储蓄或投资变得更加困难。

sentences.en: Poverty becomes self-reinforcing. Opportunities that could help people escape poverty, like moving or education, require money and time… which are the things that people in poverty often lack.
sentences.zh: 贫困变得自我强化。能够帮助人们摆脱贫困的机会，比如搬家或接受教育，需要金钱和时间……而这恰恰是贫困人口往往缺乏的东西。

sentences.en: So can poverty actually be ended? Or can it only be reduced?
sentences.zh: 那么，贫困真的能被根除吗？还是只能被减少？

sentences.en: First, it’s useful to make a distinction.
sentences.zh: 首先，做出区分是很有用的。

sentences.en: Reducing poverty means lowering the number of people living in poverty and improving living standards.
sentences.zh: 减少贫困意味着降低生活在贫困中的人数并提高生活水平。

sentences.en: Ending poverty suggests eliminating it completely.
sentences.zh: 根除贫困则意味着彻底消灭贫困。

sentences.en: Most experts agree that ending poverty everywhere, especially relative poverty, may be extremely difficult, but reducing poverty significantly is clearly possible.
sentences.zh: 大多数专家一致认为，在各地根除贫困（尤其是相对贫困）可能极其困难，但大幅减少贫困显然是可能的。

sentences.en: Over the past few decades, the world has made real progress.
sentences.zh: 在过去几十年里，世界取得了切实的进展。

sentences.en: Hundreds of millions of people have moved out of extreme poverty, especially in parts of East Asia.
sentences.zh: 数亿人已经摆脱了极端贫困，特别是在东亚部分地区。

sentences.en: Governments play a very important role in this.
sentences.zh: 政府在这方面发挥着非常重要的作用。

sentences.en: Things like social safety nets are important.
sentences.zh: 诸如社会安全网之类的事情非常重要。

sentences.en: These are systems that support people when they are unemployed, sick, elderly, or caring for others.
sentences.zh: 这些是在人们失业、生病、年老或照顾他人时为其提供支持的系统。

sentences.en: These include unemployment benefits or child support or pensions.
sentences.zh: 其中包括失业救济金、育儿补贴或养老金。

sentences.en: Policies like minimum wages and labor protections can also help ensure that people are not trapped in low paid insecure jobs.
sentences.zh: 诸如最低工资和劳动保护等政策也有助于确保人们不会陷入低薪、不稳定的工作。

sentences.en: Education is one of the most powerful tools for reducing poverty.
sentences.zh: 教育是减少贫困最强大的工具之一。

sentences.en: Education for women and girls is particularly effective.
sentences.zh: 针对妇女和女童的教育尤其有效。

sentences.en: Studies consistently show that when women are educated, families tend to be healthier, incomes rise and communities are more stable.
sentences.zh: 研究一再表明，当女性受到教育时，家庭往往更健康，收入增加，社区也更稳定。

sentences.en: Poverty is a global issue and many responses are international.
sentences.zh: 贫困是一个全球性问题，许多应对措施也是跨国的。

sentences.en: Non-governmental organizations, development agencies and international institutions provide aid, build infrastructure, and support education in lower income countries.
sentences.zh: 非政府组织、发展机构和国际机构在低收入国家提供援助、建设基础设施并支持教育。

sentences.en: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals are aiming to keep governments accountable.
sentences.zh: 联合国可持续发展目标旨在促使各国政府承担责任。

sentences.en: So to end this episode, I’d like to think a little bit about how we talk about poverty.
sentences.zh: 因此，在结束本集节目时，我想探讨一下我们如何谈论贫困。

sentences.en: Language matters. It influences how we think, feel, and act.
sentences.zh: 语言很重要。它影响着我们的思维、感受和行动方式。

sentences.en: Consider the difference between these two phrases: The first turns a complex group of individuals into a single label, “the poor “.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下这两个短语之间的区别：第一个将一个复杂的个人群体变成了一个单一的标签——“穷人”。

sentences.en: The second reminds us that poverty is a condition.
sentences.zh: 第二个提醒我们，贫困是一种状态。

sentences.en: It’s something people are facing, not their identity.
sentences.zh: 它是人们正在面对的事情，而不是他们的身份。

sentences.en: People living in poverty, they’re still people.
sentences.zh: 生活在贫困中的人，他们依然是人。

sentences.en: This may sound like a small difference, but it does affect how much empathy we feel and whether we see something as changeable.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能是一个小区别，但它确实会影响我们的同理心以及我们是否认为事情是可以改变的。

sentences.en: Whether we see poverty as changeable. Language carries hidden judgments and bias.
sentences.zh: 我们是否认为贫困是可以改变的。语言承载着隐藏的判断和偏见。

sentences.en: Words like “lazy”, “dependent” and “undeserving” are sometimes used, directly or indirectly, to describe people in poverty.
sentences.zh: “懒惰”、“依赖”和“不劳而获”等词有时被直接或间接地用来描述贫困人口。

sentences.en: These stereotypes suggest that poverty is the result of bad choices or weak character.
sentences.zh: 这些刻板印象暗示贫困是不良选择或性格薄弱的结果。

sentences.en: But as we’ve seen throughout this episode, poverty is often caused by other factors like low wages or poor health, or lack of education, discrimination, natural disasters, or conflict.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们在本集节目中所看到的，贫困通常是由其他因素引起的，比如低工资、健康状况不佳、缺乏教育、歧视、自然灾害或冲突。

sentences.en: The media and politicians play a powerful role in how poverty is discussed.
sentences.zh: 媒体和政客在如何讨论贫困的问题上发挥着巨大作用。

sentences.en: Newspaper headlines may focus on individual stories taken out of context, rather than the long-term trends or causes of poverty.
sentences.zh: 报纸头条可能会聚焦于脱离语境的个人故事，而不是贫困的长期趋势或成因。

sentences.en: And political language often frames poverty as a cost to society rather than a sign of deeper problems.
sentences.zh: 政治语言往往将贫困构筑为对社会的成本，而不是更深层次问题的信号。

sentences.en: Poverty is a sign that your country, your society, has economic and social problems.
sentences.zh: 贫困表明你的国家、你的社会存在经济和社会问题。

sentences.en: It’s not a sign that these people are causing damage to your country.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着这些人正在对你的国家造成破坏。

sentences.en: It is a sign that your country is already damaged.
sentences.zh: 这表明你的国家本身就已经受损了。

sentences.en: If poverty is something that people do to themselves, the solution is these people need to be punished or controlled.
sentences.zh: 如果贫困是人们自己造成的，那么解决方案就是惩罚或控制这些人。

sentences.en: But if we see poverty as a shared social challenge, a consequence of our society, well then solutions tend to appear in opportunity or support or prevention.​
sentences.zh: 但如果我们把贫困看作一个共同的社会挑战、一个我们社会带来的后果，那么解决方案往往就会在机会、支持或预防中显现。

sentences.en: Poverty is not simple. It is multi-dimensional and influenced by income, health, education, work, powers, and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 贫困并不简单。它是多维度的，受收入、健康、教育、工作、权力和机会的影响。

sentences.en: It’s influenced by personal circumstances and also by economic systems, policies and structures.
sentences.zh: 它受个人环境以及经济体系、政策和结构的影响。

sentences.en: There’s no single cause of poverty and no single solution.
sentences.zh: 贫困没有单一的原因，也没有单一的解决方案。

sentences.en: Ending poverty completely is probably unrealistic, at least in the short term, but reducing poverty, reducing suffering, and reducing inequality are clearly achievable.
sentences.zh: 彻底消除贫困可能并不现实，至少在短期内如此，但减少贫困、减少苦难和减少不平等显然是可以实现的。

sentences.en: But what do you think? What is the poverty line in your country?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么看？你所在国家的贫困线是多少？

sentences.en: How does your society talk about poverty or people in poverty?
sentences.zh: 你们社会是如何谈论贫困或贫困人口的？
